name: prompt-vault
description: Queue prompts in a local browser page, then let Codex claim them one at a time, carry them out, and mark each done.

interface.shortDescription: Queue prompts outside the chat transcript
interface.longDescription: Write prompts into a local browser queue stored outside the repository. Codex claims them one at a time, carries each out, and marks it done — so the prompt text never has to be pasted into chat.
defaultPrompt: Open Prompt Vault so I can queue some prompts
